nodes.rationale: Three curves (h=1, 7, 14) of the Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction against window length n, with red markers where n=h and the factor hits exactly zero — i.e. no DM variant is computable. Dropped from the chapter: it restates a formula the prose already gives.
